fact: On 12 August 2026 the Minister of Lands said the ministry is digitising land administration through LIMS, and an audit of Lilongwe Areas 3 and 10 found records not traceable and most plots unregistered.
title: Speech by Minister of Lands Chimwemwe Chipungu on the Land Ownership Audit
publisher: Malawi Cables Online (Ministry of Lands, Housing and Urban Development speech)
